photoobj_core.name: photoobj_core
photoobj_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary id
  objid,

  -- positions
  ra,
  dec,

  -- bands (keep raw numeric measures, canonical NULLs)
  g,
  r,
  i,
  u,
  z,

  -- observational metadata
  run,
  field,
  mode,
  clean,
  extinction_r
FROM photoobj
photoobj_core.description: Canonical cleaned projection of the photoobj table exposing primary id, positions, bands, and relevant observational metadata. Keeps raw numeric measures and canonical NULLs; does not apply question-specific thresholds.

specobj_core.name: specobj_core
specobj_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.class,
  s.subclass,
  s.z,
  s.zerr,
  s.zwarning,
  s.mjd,
  s.plate,
  s.fiberid
FROM
  specobj s
specobj_core.description: Canonical cleaned projection of the spectroscopic objects (specobj) exposing spectroscopy id, best matched photo obj id, classification, redshift and related quality flags. Keeps raw numeric measures and canonical NULLs; no domain thresholds applied.

photo_with_spec_match.name: photo_with_spec_match
photo_with_spec_match.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.g,
  s.specobjid,
  s.z AS spec_z,
  s.class AS spec_class
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN specobj s
  ON p.objid = s.bestobjid
photo_with_spec_match.description: Denormalized row-level join between photoobj and specobj at the level of photoobj matched to its best spectroscopic object. Exposes both photo and spectro columns for filtering and selection by downstream queries.
